title: DLMF 25.5 Integral Representations: For \theta_{3} see § 20.2(i) . For similar representations involving other theta functions see Erdélyi et al.
summary: DLMF 25.5 Integral Representations: For \theta_{3} see § 20.2(i) . For similar representations involving other theta functions see Erdélyi et al.
body: NIST DLMF section 25.5 (Integral Representations) says: "For \theta_{3} see § 20.2(i) . For similar representations involving other theta functions see Erdélyi et al. ( 1954a , p. 339) . In ( 25.5.15 )–( 25.5.19 ), 0<\Re s<1 , \psi\left(x\right) is the digamma function, and \gamma is Euler’s constant (§ 5.2 ). ( 25.5.16 ) is also valid for 0<\Re s<2 , s\neq 1 . where the integration contour is a loop around the negative real axis; it starts at -\infty , encircles the origin once in the positive direction without enclosing any of the points z=\pm 2\pi\mathrm{i} , \pm 4\pi\mathrm{i} , …, and returns to -\infty . Equivalently, The contour here is any loop that encircles the origin in the positive direction not enclosing any of the points \pm\pi\mathrm{i} , \pm 3\pi\mathrm{i} , …. For the contour of integration in ( 25.5.20 ) and ( 25.5.21 ) see Figure 5.9.1 ." Equation 25.5.5 on the page has alt text "\zeta\left(s\right)=-s\int_{0}^{\infty}\frac{x-\left\lfloor x\right\rfloor-% \frac{1}{2}}{x^{s+1}}\,\mathrm{d}x,". Equation 25.5.6 on the page has alt text "\zeta\left(s\right)=\frac{1}{2}+\frac{1}{s-1}+\frac{1}{\Gamma\left(s\right)}% \int_{0}^{\infty}\left(\frac{1}{e^{x}-1}-\frac{1}{x}+\frac{1}{2}\right)\frac{x% ^{s-1}}{e^{x}}\,\mathrm{d}x,". This card records that section's wording and equation alt text. It does not retypeset a formula the alt text did not carry.
